verdict.rationale: incident.io has a documented public REST API with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, so you could pull incident and on-call data out programmatically. Webhooks can sync on-call data to external tools, a Terraform provider captures configuration as code, and audit logs can stream to Datadog. Leaving would mean building your own extraction from these pieces; there is no evidence of a dedicated data-export feature. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), coverage of all data types (timelines, post-mortems, Scribe transcripts), offboarding or data-portability docs, and independent corroboration.
